name: 1N4004
description: Mid-range 1N400x, 400V / 1A in DO-41. The common choice for off-line (rectified mains) circuits where the 1N4001's 50V is insufficient.

extra.Rth(JA): 50 C/W typ (9.5mm lead length, PCB mounted)

typical_application: Rectifier in 120/230VAC line-powered supplies and bridges needing headroom above peak mains.
gotchas: not a fast/switching diode (no trr rating); unsuitable above a few kHz
400V is the repetitive peak rating; mains transients can exceed it, so add a snubber/MOV where needed
Vf is essentially the same as the 1N4001; only the voltage rating differs across the family
